book.title: The DevOps Handbook
book.author: Gene Kim, Jez Humble, Patrick Debois and John Willis

predict.question: B starts empty and admits and completes five each round for four rounds. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The DevOps Handbook describes limiting work in progress and making delivery flow visible.
modelBoundary: A accumulates {A} waiting jobs; B has {B}. Admitting three more than finish adds three jobs each round; matching admissions avoids that accumulation. Deterministic fixed rates only; latency, randomness and real deployment reliability are not estimated.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
